blocks.text: Glenwood Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Glenwood is the board's (GVR) name for a pocket on Port Coquitlam's north side. It is not named as an established neighbourhood in the City's Official Community Plan (OCP); it sits inside the north-side residential area, and the City publishes no boundary for it.
Lougheed Highway forms the pocket's south boundary, and Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue are its north–south routes.
Citadel lies to the east and Riverwood beyond it, with Central Port Coquitlam to the south across Lougheed Highway.

items.t: Evergreen Park at 3500 Cedar Drive is the pocket's addressed park, on the Cedar Drive street system.
Lougheed Highway is a hard south edge: everything south of it is a different part of the city, so a Glenwood address is by definition a north-side address.

blocks.text: Glenwood Houses: getting around

items.t: Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue run north–south through the pocket, and the Coast Meridian Overpass connects the north side to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass.
Lougheed Highway is the south boundary street, separating the pocket from Central Port Coquitlam.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Glenwood

Just north of Lougheed Highway, between Woodland Acres and Birchland Manor, Glenwood (which some people call Imperial Park) is a north Port Coquitlam family area. Imperial Park is the neighbourhood park, and James Park Elementary is nearby.
Glenwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

23 houses sold in Glenwood with a median price of $1,300,000 (the middle half sold between $1,129,000 and $1,381,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $538 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 35 houses listed in Glenwood. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Glenwood?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Glenwood had a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Glenwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.a: 11 houses sold in Glenwood over those 5 months, out of 91 in all of Port Coquitlam.
faq.q: How many houses sold in Glenwood from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Glenwood?

faq.a: Not by name in the Official Community Plan: the pocket is a board sub-area inside the City's north-side residential area, so City documents discuss the north side rather than a Glenwood neighbourhood plan.

faq.q: What did houses in Glenwood sell for?
faq.a: 23 houses sold in Glenwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,300,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Glenwood?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
